clue.text: President of the Royal Society limits monster's development

indicators.note: to limit something is to hem it in on both sides, so the first piece wraps around the second

parts.note: PRS is the abbreviation for this office
an ogre is a monster; the possessive keeps its S

explanation.surface: A distinguished scientist keeps a monster from growing up.
explanation.walkthrough: The Royal Society president's initials split around the monster, with the possessive S kept on the ogre.
explanation.definitionFit: Progress is forward movement or growth, a near synonym for development.

clue.text: Discuss prisoner having one ring between two wives

parts.note: a prisoner of war

indicators.note: something between two others sits in the middle of them

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for wife, twice
a ring is O-shaped

explanation.surface: A prisoner with one wedding ring and two wives has things to talk over.
explanation.definitionFit: To powwow is informally to hold a meeting and talk things over, so it means discuss.

clue.text: Working outside West Indian state line is a detrimental move

indicators.note: being outside something means surrounding it, so one part wraps another

parts.note: a machine that is on is working
the compass abbreviation
Goa is a state on India's west coast
L is the abbreviation for line

explanation.surface: Taking a job beyond a western Indian state proves a bad career move.
explanation.walkthrough: Goa is a former Portuguese colony on India's west coast, and the smallest Indian state by area.
explanation.definitionFit: An own goal is literally scoring against your own side, and figuratively any act that harms yourself.

clue.text: What hibernator hopefully does about, say, soldiers returning with spades

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: returning means going back, so the letters run in the opposite direction

parts.note: e.g. means for example, which say can also mean
REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British army corps
S is the card abbreviation for spades

explanation.surface: Soldiers come back with shovels to see whether a hibernating animal has woken.
explanation.definitionFit: A hibernating animal sleeps through winter, and in spring it comes out of its den again.

clue.text: Regressive ayatollah still restricts this foodstuff

indicators.note: regressive means going backwards, so the letters read in reverse order
what restricts something holds it in, so the answer lies within these words

parts.note: the letters run across the two words

explanation.surface: A backward-looking religious leader still limits what people may eat.
explanation.definitionFit: A shallot is a small onion-like bulb used in cooking, an item of food.

clue.text: One that stoops in autumn: short-tailed rook

indicators.note: having a short tail means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: fall is the American word for autumn
to rook someone is to cheat them, to con them

explanation.surface: A seasonal note about a bird with a stubby tail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rook' looks like the bird, sitting nicely beside a falcon, but here it is the verb meaning swindle. A falcon 'stoops' when it dives on its prey.
explanation.definitionFit: In falconry a stoop is the steep dive a hawk makes on prey, so the bird is one that stoops.

clue.text: Rebecca's back, with regret about grand feud

indicators.note: the back of a word is its end, so only its last letter is taken

parts.note: the final letter

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece goes round another

parts.note: to rue is to regret
G is short for grand, a thousand pounds

explanation.surface: Rebecca has returned and regrets a long-running family quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: RUE goes around G, after A. Rebecca is du Maurier's novel, one of this puzzle's theme names.
explanation.definitionFit: To feud is to quarrel bitterly, and to argue is to dispute, so the verbs match.

clue.text: Rachel endlessly reviewed books inside Melody Maker

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other
something reviewed is gone over again and reworked, so the letters are reordered
without an end, the name drops its last letter

parts.note: the name taken as written
the New Testament, a set of books

explanation.surface: Rachel kept reviewing books for the music paper Melody Maker.
explanation.walkthrough: Melody Maker looks like the old British music weekly; here it is the pipe of a bagpipe that plays the tune. My Cousin Rachel is another du Maurier novel.
explanation.definitionFit: The chanter is the pipe of a bagpipe with finger holes, on which the melody is played.

clue.text: Ron lists broken vents

indicators.note: something broken has its parts disarranged, so the letters come out in another order

parts.note: the letters taken as written

explanation.surface: Ron writes down the faulty air vents in a building.
explanation.definitionFit: Nostrils are the openings of the nose through which air passes, so they work as vents.

clue.text: Really enjoying getting the answers without first dropping the ball

indicators.note: dropping something moves it lower, so one letter shifts further down the word
without its first letter means the opening letter is dropped

parts.note: solving a puzzle is getting its answers
a ball is round, which stands for the letter O, the one that moves

explanation.surface: A solver is having fun getting the answers, without fumbling.
explanation.walkthrough: SOLVING loses S, then its O drops one place down the word. In a down clue that ball literally falls.
explanation.definitionFit: Loving something informally means enjoying it greatly, as in 'I'm loving this'.

clue.text: Garbo swims right out after Victor docked in Wisconsin lake

indicators.note: a docked tail is cut short, so the last letter goes

parts.note: a victor is a winner

indicators.note: something that swims moves about, so the remaining letters move into a new order
right is R in crosswords, and out says that letter is removed

parts.note: the film star's name taken as written

explanation.surface: Greta Garbo goes swimming in a Wisconsin lake after someone docks a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Victor' looks like a name, or V in the phonetic alphabet, but means the person who wins. Right is R in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Lake Winnebago is the largest lake wholly inside the US state of Wisconsin.

clue.text: Good girl tumbler?

parts.note: G is the usual abbreviation for good
a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: Is a well-behaved girl a gymnast?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tumbler' suggests an acrobat, and the question mark flags that it is the drinking vessel instead.
explanation.definitionFit: A tumbler is a flat-bottomed drinking vessel, which is a kind of glass.

clue.text: Little weight unit, and another for gas

parts.note: oz is the short form of ounce, a unit of weight
another unit, and a unit is one

explanation.surface: Someone lists small units of measurement needed for a gas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' refers back to 'unit', and a single unit is one.
explanation.definitionFit: Ozone is a pale blue gas made of three oxygen atoms, found high in the atmosphere.

clue.text: Deviously elect Sire Dudley (as he was historically known)

indicators.note: acting deviously means going by a crooked route, so the letters take a winding new order

parts.note: the letters taken as written

explanation.surface: A scheming election puts a nobleman named Dudley in power.
explanation.walkthrough: Robert Dudley, favourite of Elizabeth I, was made Earl of Leicester and was widely known by that title.
explanation.definitionFit: Robert Dudley held the earldom of Leicester, so in his own era he was commonly called by that title.

clue.text: Following soft steps

parts.note: f. is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
a light touch is a soft one

explanation.surface: Someone walks quietly behind another person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soft steps' reads as quiet footfalls, but 'steps' is the definition alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight is a series of stairs between two floors, a run of steps.

clue.text: Kelly really regularly dispatched someone in the military

parts.note: Gene Kelly, the American dancer and actor of Singin' in the Rain

indicators.note: dispatching letters at regular intervals leaves every other one behind

parts.note: the first, third and fifth letters survive

explanation.surface: Someone named Kelly was sent off to serve in the forces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kelly' looks like a soldier's surname; it is the first name of Gene Kelly.
explanation.definitionFit: A general is a high-ranking army officer, so certainly a member of the military.

clue.text: Plan clues entangled in concept of linear algebra

indicators.note: things that are entangled are twisted together, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: the letters taken as written

explanation.surface: A setter plans clues that get tangled up in maths.
explanation.definitionFit: The null space of a matrix is the set of vectors it sends to zero, a standard idea in linear algebra.

clue.text: Enlightened writer's boss holds up English antique coin

indicators.note: in a down clue, holding something up means sitting below it to support it

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for English
a ducat is an old gold coin of Europe
the editor, abbreviated ed.

explanation.surface: An editor supports an English writer by producing an old coin.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone educated has been taught and informed, and so is enlightened.

clue.text: Lowered the moral character of Daphne's missing content when retired?

indicators.note: with its contents missing only the outside shell of the name is kept

parts.note: only the first and last letters stay
someone who has retired for the night has gone to bed
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: Daphne du Maurier's books lose their substance once she stops writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when retired' is read as 'when' placed in 'retired', so no separate insertion word is needed. Daphne du Maurier wrote this puzzle's theme novels.
explanation.definitionFit: To debase someone is to lower their quality or moral worth, so the past tense matches the phrase.

clue.text: Hub in Menabilly drops telephones

indicators.note: a hub is the centre of a wheel, so just the middle letter is wanted

parts.note: the fifth of its nine letters
to drop something is to lower it

explanation.surface: The centre of du Maurier's Cornish house loses its phones.
explanation.walkthrough: Menabilly is the Cornish house du Maurier lived in, model for Manderley. Blower is British slang for a telephone.
explanation.definitionFit: Blower is old British slang for a telephone, so blowers are telephones.

clue.text: Du Maurier's first and last discs by Paul McCartney's Wings are feeble

indicators.note: the first and last letters of the name are taken and the middle ignored

parts.note: D and R are its outer letters
discs are round, two letter Os

indicators.note: wings are the two sides, so the outer letters of the name are kept

parts.note: P and Y are its outer letters

explanation.surface: Records by Daphne du Maurier and by McCartney's band Wings are poor.
explanation.walkthrough: Wings was Paul McCartney's band after the Beatles, which makes the word look like part of a name rather than an instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Something droopy hangs down limply, lacking vigour, so it is feeble.

clue.text: Seize her in the auditorium, Groucho!

indicators.note: an auditorium is where words are heard, so we go by sound rather than spelling

parts.note: said out loud these words sound like the Roman leader's surname

explanation.surface: Groucho Marx yells at a theatre to grab a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The sound gives Caesar, and the step to Julius Caesar's first name is left to the solver. Groucho Marx was born Julius Henry Marx.
explanation.definitionFit: Groucho was the stage name of Julius Henry Marx, so his real first name fits.

clue.text: Force chartered accountants' organisation to admit a country

indicators.note: to admit something is to let it in, so a letter goes inside

parts.note: to jam something in is to force it
taken as written
the Institute of Chartered Accountants

explanation.surface: Someone pressures an accountants' body to let in a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Jamaica is an island country in the Caribbean.

clue.text: Upstanding banana DNA guy protects one from Africa

indicators.note: in a down clue standing up means reading from the bottom upward
what protects something wraps around it, so the answer is inside these words

parts.note: the letters run across the three words

explanation.surface: An honest scientist working on banana genes looks after an African.
explanation.definitionFit: A Ugandan is a person from Uganda, a country in East Africa.

clue.text: Some rays of light seen in headland fire

indicators.note: something seen in a place is within it, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a spit is a narrow point of land running into the sea
infrared, abbreviated IR

explanation.surface: Light rays are visible in a fire on a coastal point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fire' looks like the blaze on the headland, but means spirit as in passion.
explanation.definitionFit: Fire and spirit both mean energetic courage or passion, as in a horse full of fire.

clue.text: Social group at skid row, Oxford met occasionally in clothes store

indicators.note: occasionally means at intervals, so only letters at set spacing are used

parts.words: Social group at skid row, Oxford met
parts.note: every third letter, beginning with the third

explanation.surface: A club gathers on a down-and-out street in Oxford, meeting now and then in a wardrobe.
explanation.definitionFit: A cloakroom is a room where coats and bags are left, a store for outdoor clothing.

clue.text: Two books of family genealogies with only the covers remaining

parts.note: kin are family

indicators.note: the covers of a book are on the outside, so only the outer letters remain

parts.note: its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Two volumes of family trees are stripped down to their bindings.
explanation.walkthrough: The Bible has two Books of Kings, 1 Kings and 2 Kings.
explanation.definitionFit: Kings is the name of a pair of Old Testament books, First and Second Kings.

clue.text: Rapscallion's initially suspicious about politician

indicators.note: initially points to the beginning, so just the first letter is taken

parts.note: its first letter
ca. is circa, Latin for about
a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A rogue is wary of some MP.
explanation.definitionFit: A scamp is a mischievous rascal, the same as a rapscallion.

clue.text: Quaint northern child growing up fast?

parts.note: twee is British for quaint in a sugary way
N is the abbreviation for northern

explanation.surface: A charming child from the north is growing up quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks a playful definition: children aged about ten to twelve are said to grow up fast.
explanation.definitionFit: A tween is a child between about ten and twelve, nearly a teenager and maturing quickly.

clue.text: Have a fling with two royals who've departed in recent times

wordplay.words: two royals who've departed in recent times
wordplay.note: Prince Philip (Phil) and Queen Elizabeth II (ER), joined by 'and'

explanation.surface: Someone flirts with a pair of royals who recently left.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'two royals' are read as PHIL AND ER: Prince Philip died in 2021 and Elizabeth Regina in 2022.
explanation.definitionFit: To philander is to have casual love affairs, so having a fling describes it.

clue.text: Stop South Asian living abroad with holy woman

parts.note: desi is a term for a person of South Asian descent, especially in the diaspora
a saint, abbreviated St

explanation.surface: A South Asian expatriate is told to halt by a nun.
explanation.definitionFit: To desist is to cease doing something, the same as to stop.

clue.text: Dadaist of the highest level, finally de Winter can transgress art

parts.note: the max is the maximum, the highest level

indicators.note: finally points at the end of each word, so only the closing letters count

parts.note: the last letter of each of the five words

explanation.surface: A top-ranking Dadaist, Mrs de Winter, may break the rules of art.
explanation.walkthrough: De Winter is the husband's family in du Maurier's Rebecca, one of this puzzle's theme names.
explanation.definitionFit: Max Ernst was a German painter who was a leading figure in the Dada movement.
